scope: Read-only public portfolio research; no login, signup, client application access or live workflow testing.

observations.source_observation: Proposals support signatures and locked exports.
observations.proposed_workflow: Record covered companies, GSTINs, periods, services and reviewer rights; accept a versioned engagement scope; changes require a new acceptance.
observations.constraint: Optional supporting capability for external-CA relationships; not government filing authorization or proof of legal e-signature support.

observations.source_observation: Accepted proposals become assignments.
observations.proposed_workflow: An accepted GST engagement creates only its applicable period work, checklist and responsible preparer/reviewer; detect overlapping engagements.
observations.constraint: Our proposed GST adaptation; JCSS native GST calculation or filing is not established.

observations.source_observation: Assignments contain teams, forms and milestones.
observations.proposed_workflow: Offer editable templates for period close, notice response and migration; show missing evidence, dependencies, responsibility and completion criteria.
observations.constraint: Templates must be reviewed for taxpayer applicability; a completed task does not imply statutory completion.

observations.source_observation: Company profiles reuse statutory identifiers.
observations.proposed_workflow: Use the existing company/GSTIN/branch records consistently in documents and engagements; flag stale verification and retain effective-dated changes.
observations.constraint: No need to add corporate-secretarial director/shareholder registers merely because they appear in JCSS.

observations.source_observation: Tasks have owner, due date and status.
observations.proposed_workflow: Separate statutory due date, internal target and reminder; record blocking dependencies, reason for delay, reassignment and evidence for closure.
observations.constraint: Source establishes basic task controls; dependency rules are our proposal.

observations.source_observation: Recurring monthly and quarterly tasks are generated.
observations.proposed_workflow: Create each obligation once for the active registration and period; preview a rule change; suspend after cancellation; preserve previously generated work.
observations.constraint: Do not hardcode dates from screenshots or confuse scheduled task creation with return filing.

observations.source_observation: Portfolio tasks support filters and bulk actions.
observations.proposed_workflow: Save GSTIN/period/owner/reason filters; preview selected rows; limit bulk actions by permissions; retain per-record outcomes.
observations.constraint: Bulk approval must not silently approve hidden records or bypass case evidence.

observations.source_observation: Clients see only their engagements.
observations.proposed_feature: Business and CA shared status view
observations.proposed_workflow: Business staff see requests and period readiness; assigned CAs see permitted client work; revoke client access and export a handover pack.
observations.constraint: Company isolation, business-scope permissions and GST filing authority remain distinct.

observations.source_observation: Documents, changes and sign-offs have history.
observations.proposed_workflow: Preserve preparation snapshot, reviewer decision, changes after approval and the official acknowledgement; require renewed review of affected changes.
observations.constraint: Reaffirm existing scope; do not count as a separate new module.

observations.source_observation: Internal comments and client notifications are described.
observations.proposed_workflow: Separate internal review notes from business-visible document requests; keep discussions on the affected invoice or period; consolidate reminders.
observations.constraint: External message delivery remains a later authorized connector decision.

observations.source_observation: Bulk imports offer validation previews.
observations.proposed_workflow: Preview column mappings, duplicates, missing fields and monetary control totals; import accepted rows; produce a rejected-row correction file.
observations.constraint: Mortgage file formats are not ERP requirements; our supported formats need actual customer examples.

observations.source_observation: Scenarios specify steps, evidence and failures.
observations.proposed_workflow: For a reviewed tax policy revision, compare representative customer transactions before and after; attach reason and accountant sign-off.
observations.constraint: This proposes business validation evidence, not a mortgage UAT subsystem or statutory assurance.

observations.source_observation: Reruns preserve prior result versions.
observations.proposed_workflow: When a statement import or invoice changes, show differences against the previous reconciliation/review; supersede its result without erasing it.
observations.constraint: Record which approvals were affected; recalculation must not silently rewrite filed snapshots.

observations.source_observation: Notes, files and PDF evidence accompany tests.
observations.proposed_workflow: Build a filtered dossier with source documents, calculations, unresolved cases and reviewer decisions; include scope and generation timestamp.
observations.constraint: Exported evidence is not independently certified or accepted by a tax authority merely because it is a PDF.

observations.source_observation: Dashboards report failures, trends and workload.
observations.proposed_workflow: Show recurring mismatch causes, evidence backlog, reopened review count and reviewer capacity alongside affected amounts.
observations.constraint: Operational indicators must not be presented as legal risk scores without a defined and reviewed basis.

observations.source_observation: Tester, manager, admin and owner roles are described.
observations.proposed_workflow: Keep the existing staff/accountant model; test visibility and actions independently across company, branch, GSTIN and approval responsibilities.
observations.constraint: Do not copy mortgage role names into our webapp.

observations.source_observation: Indexed landing page advertises finance capture and private beta.
observations.proposed_workflow: Connect spending, open supplier bills, receivables and reconciled bank position; show as-of dates and unresolved differences.
observations.constraint: Indexed page was crawled approximately three months before retrieval; live status and production completeness unverified.

observations.source_observation: Mockup shows tax, contributor, currency and payment columns.
observations.proposed_workflow: Record invoice owner, company GSTIN, paid-by party, payment proof, department and purpose; review reimbursements and prevent double claims or postings.
observations.constraint: Mockup tax labels are not tax advice; overseas purchases require contextual GST review, not automatic out-of-scope classification.

observations.source_observation: Mockup shows cash, receivables, expenses and tax estimate.
observations.proposed_workflow: Show reconciled cash separately from forecast cash; distinguish estimated liability from approved liability and payments; drill down to calculation evidence.
observations.constraint: Example amounts and a generic due date have no statutory significance.

observations.source_observation: Mockup navigation includes vendors, clients and payslips.
observations.proposed_workflow: Retain existing vendor/customer masters and documented payroll scope; link permitted expense reimbursements without exposing confidential salary details.
observations.constraint: Navigation alone proves neither payroll engine breadth nor implemented vendor/client workflows.

observations.source_observation: Email and WhatsApp receipt capture are posed as possibilities.
observations.proposed_workflow: Extend the evidence inbox with source, sender and received time; preview extracted fields and potential duplicates before reviewer-approved posting.
observations.constraint: Email/WhatsApp integration remains unverified and deferred; local uploaded examples can define the workflow without choosing connectivity.

observations.source_observation: Discusses missed reimbursements and disconnected payments.
observations.proposed_workflow: Before drafting a customer reminder, inspect payment allocation and unresolved bank entries; mark suspected receipt cases for review.
observations.constraint: Bank evidence does not by itself prove tax eligibility, return filing or invoice classification.

observations.source_observation: Sports scoring, operator control and live displays.
observations.proposed_workflow: Use the already planned collaboration pattern to show freshness, pending changes and refresh needs in authorized business screens.
observations.constraint: No sports scoreboards, clocks, branding or venue-management product scope is added.

observations.source_observation: Threat dashboards, event logs and honeypot management.
observations.proposed_workflow: No additional ERP feature proposed from domain-specific cybersecurity tooling.
observations.constraint: Protecting our ERP remains necessary; building a SOC/honeypot product is unrelated scope.

source_quality_notes: Byteception is a product engineering studio; client case studies are not features of one ERP SKU.
JCSS case study contains an unfinished testimonial placeholder, so its outcome assertions lack independent testimonial corroboration on that page.
Direct Jupikit fetch returned HTTP403; only indexed first-party landing content was inspected.
Sense IoT and video-wall portfolio references are unrelated industry projects, not ERP parity requirements.
Proposed workflows are our adaptations to the existing Marg+GST scope, not claims of Byteception GST capabilities.
